note: Strategy on CD38 × HLA-DR for CD8 activation: (1) Find the dense main cluster — it splits along CD38 into two dense clouds: a left dense cloud (CD38-) = CD8_38negDRneg (the dominant population) and a right dense cloud (CD38+) = CD8_38posDRneg. These two dense clouds together form the lower (HLA-DR mid/low) band. (2) Above these dense clouds, the HLA-DR-high region forms a sparser cloud. Apply the same CD38 threshold from (1) to split this upper sparse cloud: CD38- side = CD8_38negDRpos (upper-left); CD38+ side = CD8_Activated (upper-right).
tips: CD8 activation / proliferation state (parallel annotation to Step 5 on the CD8 parent; mirror of Step 4 for CD8). HLA-DR = activation; CD38 = proliferation. CD8_Activated: CD38+ HLA-DR+. CD8_38negDRpos: CD38- HLA-DR+. CD8_38posDRneg: CD38+ HLA-DR-. CD8_38negDRneg: CD38- HLA-DR-.
